Subject: Post-discovery: Technical demo + compliance introductions

Hi Ben —

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery: Horizon AI is evaluating a serving/runtime that can meet sub-100ms tail latency for your query patterns, provide KV-cache isolation for multi-tenant pipelines, and integrate with SSO + centralized logging for auditability.

Next step: we recommend a 60-minute technical deep dive where Marissa (solutions) will walk through a tailored demo of the runtime and Karthik (platform) can cover SSO/infra requirements. Two windows that work for our team:

- Thu Jun 10, 10:00–11:00 AM PT
- Fri Jun 11, 2:00–3:00 PM PT

Can you confirm which slot works or suggest 1–2 alternatives? Also: to make the session productive, can you loop in your security and procurement contacts (email addresses) so we can cover evidence and purchasing path up front?

Attached: discovery-notes-20270608.pdf (short call notes + key requirements).

Proposed demo agenda (short):
- 5m quick recap of goals
- 25m targeted demo (latency/cost controls, routing)
- 15m SSO / evidence / compliance Q&A
- 15m procurement / next steps

Thanks — I’ll hold the two slots for now and update when you confirm.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference
